process.heading: A Structured 6-Step Workflow
process.subheading: Clear methodology from initial discovery through to production deployment.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: Understanding your business goals, target audience, key features, and project scope.

steps.title: Plan
steps.description: Mapping site architecture, user journeys, database schemas, and technical approach.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: Crafting clean, accessible component systems and responsive visual layouts.

steps.title: Develop
steps.description: Building performant, maintainable code using Next.js, React, and TypeScript.

steps.title: Test
steps.description: Comprehensive audit of responsiveness, cross-browser compatibility, and speed.

steps.title: Launch
steps.description: Deploying to production, domain setup, SSL, and handover documentation.

about.heading: Bridging business analytics, web development, and digital products.
about.intro: I am a Business Analytics & AI student at EMAA Business School in Agadir, Morocco, focused on building practical web applications, business tools, and storefronts.
about.intersectionText: My approach combines business understanding with software development. Rather than relying solely on theoretical coursework, I learn by engineering complete digital products that solve real operational challenges.
about.proofText: My technical foundation is proven through deployed applications like BusinessOS—a 15-model operational platform with role-based permissions and real-time analytics—along with responsive storefronts and web tools.
about.experienceText: During my internship at Wilaya de la Région Souss-Massa (Préfecture d'Agadir Ida Outanane), I observed public administrative workflows firsthand, strengthening my understanding of organizational data and system requirements.
about.directionText: I am working toward a career combining Data Analytics, AI, and Software Engineering. I am currently open for internship opportunities, junior roles, and selected freelance collaborations where I can build useful web applications.
